title: Threshold alerts on a reading stream
description: Scan the readings in order, numbering them from 1. At the start no alert is active. A reading strictly above limit while no alert is active starts an alert: print `ALERT N: V` (N the position, V the reading). A reading at or below limit while an alert is active ends it: print `CLEAR N: V`. Every other reading prints nothing, so staying above the limit does not repeat the alert, and a reading equal to limit counts as not above. If an alert is still active after the last reading, print `still above at end` as the final line. Return how many alerts were started.
notes: Level 2. One bit of state carried across the scan (edge detection, not per-reading filtering). A reading equal to limit is not above, so it ends an active alert; negative readings and limits are only compared; the closing line appears only when the scan ends inside an alert.
